label: A contained individuating stand-in guiding value-dependent favouring is apprehended
paraphrase: OPEN containment-recognition bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every bearer b with a favouring determination of profile phi, every scenario s and candidates z, w: if phi depends on betterness (read as value) with end-realization held fixed (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2) for z over w or for w over z at s, z is not a present input at s, b's stand-in for z is contained in b, and it differs from b's stand-in for w, then that stand-in is a content about z and b itself apprehends it. Its antecedent is narrower than the cognition criterion's (containment and individuation are required) and its consequent more specific (the apprehended content is the stand-in). It is the step from a contained, individuating item that guides value-dependent favouring to intentional presence. A virtual reading of the containment (a power to produce z, or a mode in which the bearer is imitable by z, not apprehended) denies it; nothing in the Lean types separates the two readings.
